agent_note: First-person narrator. 21 event quotes, 14 present / 7 past (66.7% present). The past minority is not incidental memory: q07987, q08011, q08013, q08014 are extended retrospective passages recounting the earlier relationship and childhood, which reads as a sustained past-tense strand alongside a present-tense main line — hence 'dual'. An analyst preferring the 'present + recollection strand' reading has the same evidence; the split is structural either way, not noise. Marks survive well here (about half of dialogue quotes retain them); marks-absent dialogue was identified by second-person direct address, vocatives and speech register, recorded per quote. Flip-risk quotes: q08016 (marginal mark majority), q08002 (gnomic vs event/present), q08020 (dialogue vs event/past).
